greeting: Good morning, Zuhair. A big week for AI, so grab a coffee and settle in.

lead.headline: Anthropic lists on Nasdaq in the largest IPO on record
lead.summary: Anthropic began trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT after pricing at $83 a share, above its earlier range. Shares opened at $111.50 in what reports describe as the biggest US listing ever, though the price eased back later in the session.

stories.headline: Training physical computers with optical dynamics
stories.summary: Published in Nature Computational Science, this work from the University of Tokyo redesigns the learning process so physical optical systems can run deep learning more naturally rather than just scaling up models. It is getting attention as a route to more energy-efficient AI hardware.

stories.headline: Meta's system for catching tiny performance regressions
stories.summary: This ACM Transactions on Computer Systems article by Yang Wang and Mike Chow combines Meta's ServiceLab (OSDI 2024) and FBDetect (SOSP 2024) work, detecting slowdowns as small as about 0.005% across millions of servers. It appears in the journal's November 2026 issue.

stories.headline: Communications of the ACM November 2026 issue
stories.summary: The latest issue of CACM is out, including a viewpoint by Ian Foster on agency as a new organising idea for computer science. Worth a browse for current thinking on AI and computing.

stories.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 in Astra and Sol versions
stories.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 arrived on 17 November as two models: Astra for long, hard projects and Sol for everyday work. Early benchmark comparisons put Astra slightly ahead of rival frontier models.

stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon as a cheaper mid-tier model
stories.summary: Google says Gemini 4 Neon, which sits between its Carbon and Hydrogen models, matches or beats rivals on an independent intelligence index while costing less.

stories.headline: Anthropic's debut tops SpaceX as the biggest IPO ever
stories.summary: Reports put the Anthropic offering at roughly $81 billion, with its valuation reaching around $2 trillion at points during the first day of trading.

stories.headline: Police investigate three separate Melbourne stabbings
stories.summary: ABC Melbourne reports that police are looking into three stabbings across the city, one of them fatal, with five teenagers arrested.

stories.headline: Liberal preferences could decide inner-city seats
stories.summary: With the Victorian election looming, how the Liberals place their preferences could be decisive in inner Melbourne seats where the Greens are competing.

stories.headline: Storm coach Craig Bellamy to leave after 2027 season
stories.summary: Melbourne Storm coach Craig Bellamy has said he will step away at the end of the 2027 NRL season.

stories.headline: COP31 ends in Antalya without a climate pact
stories.summary: The UN climate summit closed on 22 November with no overarching agreement, the first such outcome since 2009, after the EU rejected a text that omitted fossil fuels. The UN chief called the result deeply disappointing.

stories.headline: Climate talks fall apart in the final hours over fossil fuels
stories.summary: NPR describes the closing hours of COP31, where disputes over fossil fuels and climate finance sank the proposed Antalya Pact.

thought: The best way to predict the future is to invent it. - Alan Kay
